split.description: Current preprocessing concatenates original train/test arrays and takes first 30 of 50 trials for training. Its equivalence to the publication split and trial identities has not been authenticated.

inputs.description: Single-trial spikes and the disclosed stimulation protocol. Source code generates targets at floor((500+125*k)/5), k=0,...,15; that public schedule must remain equally available.

preprocessing.description: Pinned code bins 1 ms samples into 5 ms normalized sums and estimates logit baseline from the first 500 ms with a 0.001 floor. Exact publication configuration remains unresolved.

metric.description: Current code binarizes positive predictions, marks target neighborhoods within two bins, and computes hit-count/target-count and outside-neighborhood-prediction-count/prediction-count. Miss=1-min(mean_hit,1). Multi-matches count; this is not one-to-one recall or F1. Publication-to-code parity remains unverified.

aggregation.description: compute_hit_rate averages row-level hit and false fractions, after summing kernel/time axes; the plot clips the mean hit to one. Authentic trial/neuron reshaping and the Figure 4F producer remain unjoined.

full_panel.description: Preserve the original ten-neuron whisker analysis: Figure 4F joint DUNL miss/false point, every source smoothed-raster threshold comparator, separate train/test roles where the original analysis reports them, disclosed schedule-only control, and data-dependent kernel/amplitude/response companion outputs including separately reported 16-event and 18-event reconstruction R-squared. permitted_observations.description: Both conditions must receive the same complete original spike observations, binning/baseline context, trial origins and disclosed periodic stimulation schedule and top-k assistance. blocking_issues: The exact Figure 4F DUNL missed/false point and complete smoothed-raster threshold curve are not recovered as source result artifacts; the publication smoothing and threshold settings are not authenticated. Current code defaults are not substituted.

The complete original whisker assay file/checksum manifest, ten-neuron eligibility and animal/session/pair/trial identities are unjoined. Ten selected neurons versus eleven allocated channels require explicit reconciliation without dropping a source row.

The publication split, stored original trial roles, current first-30/rest-20 reassignment, saved training/selection configuration, author checkpoint and result-array producer are unjoined. Repeated test logging prevents assuming an untouched selection boundary.

The full finding panel requires the Figure 4F curve and data-dependent shared kernel, neuron/event amplitudes and response reconstructions as companion evidence. The scalar findings below are only identified members; unknown source curve cardinality and kernel/response comparison criteria prevent claiming that the executable panel is complete.

No source-grounded numerical agreement tolerances or biological uncertainty rule are established. Events, repeated group rows, allocated channels and time bins cannot be counted as independent biological replicates; no sample minimum is invented.

The accepted historical event interface consumes already-exported owner targets and candidate codes for current defaults; it neither runs submitted analysis nor authenticates original input tensors, native export, kernel/amplitude/rate outputs or the full smoothed-raster comparator. A complete independent granular-output verifier is missing.

No authentic immutable cohort/split/panel/observations/metric/aggregation manifests, common input delivery, code-only information addition, exposure policy or cumulative access/resource budgets have been frozen. Both paired protocols remain unresolved.

The target event schedule is public (16 events, 500 ms phase, 125 ms period; 5 ms grid) and top-k16/top-k18 assistance is disclosed. Agreement from a schedule-only executable or printed paper aggregates cannot demonstrate data-dependent computational reproduction.

Secondary 16-event and 18-event reconstruction targets mentioned in prior metadata have not been independently verified against retained primary paper/result evidence. Their expected values remain null; inherited contract wording is not primary verification.
